program.title: BEng in Electronic Engineering
uncertain: total_required_credits is a calculated value: the PDF does not state a fixed total for the major; it is the sum of the required_credits of all groups (using the lower bound for credit ranges such as 9-10, 4-5, 4-6).

Several blocks allow alternative course choices (e.g. ELEC/MATH 3-courses-out-of-5 block, COMP blocks, MATH calculus block, PHYS blocks, ELEC 4900/4901/4910), so the actual credits taken by a student may differ from the calculated total.
The 'ELEC 3000-level or above Electives' group (21 credits) does not have a specific course list in the PDF ('Courses of the subject and level as specified'), so its courses array is empty.

The PDF header/footer shows '2026-27 ELEC (4Y) (2025-26 intake)', i.e. the document is the 2025-26 intake curriculum rendered on a 2026-27 template; the year is recorded as 2025-26 per the intake year.
